capabilities: search GIFs by keywords in a modal
insert random GIFs at the cursor
configure the plugin with a Giphy API key
extras: The README is written in French. Users must obtain their own Giphy API key and enter it in the plugin settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search an online GIF library and insert animated GIFs into notes.

relations.evidence: Grâce à l'intégration de l'API Giphy, vous pouvez rechercher et ajouter des GIFs animés

summary: Giphy-powered plugin that searches GIFs by keyword or inserts random animated GIFs at the cursor in a note.
